title: Internal Hom for arbitrary finite-stage constructible complexes
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum, with $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Let $\ell\ne p$ be a prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be a finite extension with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and let $n\geq1$ be an integer. Put $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and let $d\in\mathbf Z_{\geq0}$ satisfy $\dim X\leq d$, using topological Krull dimension [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Work on either the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] or the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] of $X$, with constant coefficient ring sheaf $A_X$. Use bounded constructibility on the chosen site [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes, def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility], and let $D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ be its full subcategory of objects of finite Tor amplitude [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]: an object has Tor amplitude in $[u,v]$ when its derived tensor product with every $A_X$-module sheaf in degree zero has cohomology only in degrees $u$ through $v$.

For all $K,L\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ the derived internal Hom $R\mathcal Hom_A(K,L)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] is bounded constructible of finite Tor amplitude. More precisely, for any integers $a\leq b$ and $c\leq e$, if $K$ and $L$ have Tor amplitude in $[a,b]$ and $[c,e]$, respectively, then $R\mathcal Hom_A(K,L)$ has Tor amplitude in $[c-b-2d,e-a+2d]$.

proof.text:
First work on the etale site. Put $\omega_X=Ra_X^!A$ and $D_X=R\mathcal Hom_A(-,\omega_X)$ as in [thm-fix-general-biduality]. Its biduality isomorphism $\delta_L:L\xrightarrow{\sim}D_XD_XL$, followed by the ringed-site currying isomorphism of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-internal-hom-exact-restriction] at $(K,D_XL,\omega_X)$, gives

$$
R\mathcal Hom_A(K,L)\xrightarrow{\sim}
R\mathcal Hom_A(K,R\mathcal Hom_A(D_XL,\omega_X))
\xrightarrow{\sim}
R\mathcal Hom_A(K\otimes_A^LD_XL,\omega_X)
=D_X(K\otimes_A^LD_XL).
$$
The first arrow applies the covariant second-variable functor $R\mathcal Hom_A(K,-)$ to $\delta_L$. The second is the cited natural isomorphism, which has no perfectness hypothesis.

source.place: ## Proof, first paragraph: biduality and tensor–Hom identity

proof.text:
By [lem-weil-verdier-preservation-strata] applied to $L$, the complex $D_XL$ is in $D^b_{ctf}(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ with Tor amplitude in $[-e-2d,-c]$. Clause (ii) of [lem-sf-tensor-ctf], applied to $K$ and $D_XL$, puts $T=K\otimes_A^LD_XL$ in $D^b_{ctf}$ with Tor amplitude in $[a-e-2d,b-c]$. Apply [lem-weil-verdier-preservation-strata] to this $T$: its dual is bounded constructible with Tor amplitude in

$$
[-(b-c)-2d,-(a-e-2d)]=[c-b-2d,e-a+2d].
$$
Step 1 identifies this dual with the required internal Hom, so the asserted constructibility and interval follow on the etale site.

source.place: ## Proof, second paragraph: the two duality bounds and tensor bound

proof.text:
Now let $K,L$ be on the pro-etale site, and write $
u_X:X_{\mathrm{proet}}	o X_{\mathrm{et}}$ for the comparison morphism. By clause (ii) of [lem-sf-proetale-constructible-origin], choose bounded constructible etale complexes $K',L'$ with $
u_X^*K'\cong K$ and $
u_X^*L'\cong L$. Clause (ii) of [lem-sf-comparison-tor-amplitude] gives their original intervals $[a,b]$ and $[c,e]$ on the etale site. Steps 1–2 therefore put $H'=R\mathcal Hom_A(K',L')$ in $D^b_{ctf}(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ with interval $[c-b-2d,e-a+2d]$. The internal-Hom comparison of [lem-weil-finite-duality-site-comparison], applicable because $K'$ is finite-Tor constructible and $L'$ is bounded constructible, identifies

$$

u_X^*H'\cong R\mathcal Hom_A(
u_X^*K',
u_X^*L')\cong R\mathcal Hom_A(K,L).
$$
Clause (i) of [lem-sf-comparison-tor-amplitude] makes $
u_X^*H'$ bounded constructible with exactly that Tor interval. This proves the pro-etale assertion for all $K,L$ in the stated category.
